required: overlay_before exact map of all eight destinations
D overlay before sha256/ACL/attributes equal frozen snapshot
external setup overlay before sha256/ACL/attributes/native identity from reviewed plan
global_config_before exact sha256/ACL/attributes/native identity from reviewed plan

global_config_edit.offset: zero-based byte offset of old script token

plan_schema.binding: plan bytes must match supplied SHA256 and live before bytes; after bytes must exactly equal independently reviewed evidence artifact

required: previous_receipt_sha256 exact prior or null snapshot
source_review {path,sha256} JSON with matching card/source hashes and verdict ACCEPT_SOURCE_FOR_PHASE_REVIEW
qa_acceptance {path,sha256} JSON with matching card/source hashes and verdict ACCEPT_FOCUSED_QA_FOR_OPERATION
phase_admission_schema.verify_extra: coordinator_readonly_receipt {path,sha256} bound to ACTIVE hash/generation; outcome PASS, read_only=true, transport_calls=0, exact pinned executed bos_dev/codex_channel hashes, C/D/default successful canonical D/root/lock results, native two-process C/D same byte-lock identity with raw exit codes 0/0, and C/D/default same-ledger SHA evidence with PASS
phase_admission_schema.trust_boundary: root and independent reviewers produce actual admissions and native receipts; this code validates binding and freshness and does not invent them

quiescence_schema.each_actor: disposition STOPPED|DRAINED|PAUSED|INAPPLICABLE_REVIEWED plus native_receipt {path,sha256} inside evidence root
quiescence_schema.special: heartbeat PAUSED and transport DRAINED, with native receipts
quiescence_schema.freshness: checked at phase entry and again immediately before consequential switching steps

snapshot: existing core state JSON envelope validation
prepare: target.expected.json derived from snapshot+exact overlay/new identity deltas
PREPARED anchor published only to absent name
alias: PREPARED anchor with final prepared ref

identity_and_copy.filesystem: supported local NTFS only; 64-bit core identity on ReFS refused
identity_and_copy.native_identity: GetFileInformationByHandle volume serial 8 lowercase hex and file index 16 lowercase hex
identity_and_copy.objects: ordinary local paths, no unexpected ancestor/leaf reparse, regular single-link files, full directory traversal, no ADS/EFS/compression/sparse
identity_and_copy.security: owner/group/ordered DACL bytes and DACL control fingerprint via GetSecurityInfo/SetSecurityInfo with readback; null/missing DACL refused; private target/backup ACL before secret bytes
identity_and_copy.not_claimed: SACL/audit/MIC and unsupported metadata are not inferred preserved

junction: one CreateDirectoryW plus one FSCTL_SET_REPARSE_POINT mount point, GET_REPARSE_POINT and C/D root+lock native readback; no cmd/mklink fallback
archive: MoveFileExW(source, archive, 0) same parent and native volume, no copy/replace/delay flags
receipts: immutable exclusive same-parent temp, file fsync, publish to absent name, exact digest and ACL readback; started marker remains on any failure
anchor: exact 11-key bos3.control-home-authority/v1; initial PREPARED uses absent-name publication, later replacements require prior exact hash/native file identity/phase/generation immediately before replace; post-alias immutable final prepared reference, ACTIVE only after independent receipt binding
full_target_readback: immutable target.expected.json derived from frozen C snapshot and only accepted D overlays/new native identities; full D path set/type/size/hash/ACL/attributes/identity/approved metadata rechecked before alias, ACTIVE and verify; external setup/config and backups checked for exact bytes/type/ACL/attributes/identity
state_envelopes: existing config version=1+lanes object, queue version=1+tasks object, observer JSON object and delivery schema=1+messages object; bytes and unknown records preserved
durability_boundary: Regular file temp flush/fsync and atomic same-parent publication/readback are required. No directory fsync or whole-operation power-loss transaction is claimed; uncertain outcome requires separate persisted-state reconciliation.
